name: canon
description: Canonical identifier resolution — maps raw IDs to canonical forms using a versioned registry

arguments.name: input
arguments.description: Input CSV or JSONL file. Format detected by extension (.csv, .tsv, .jsonl, .ndjson). Use - for stdin (JSONL only).

options.name: registry
options.description: Registry directory containing registry.json and mapping files

options.name: column
options.description: Column containing IDs to resolve

options.name: emit
options.description: Output mode: json (JSON mapping) or csv (CSV with canonical column)

options.name: canon_column
options.description: Name of appended canonical column (default: <COLUMN>__canon). CSV mode only.

options.name: map_out
options.description: Write JSON mapping artifact to file (sidecar). CSV mode only.

options.name: max_rows
options.description: Refuse if input exceeds N data rows

options.name: max_bytes
options.description: Refuse if input exceeds N bytes

options.name: no_witness
options.description: Suppress witness ledger recording

options.name: explicit
options.description: Show entity names and identifiers in JSON output (default: redacted for zero-retention safety)

options.name: describe
options.description: Print compiled operator.json and exit 0

options.name: schema
options.description: Print canon.v0 JSON Schema and exit 0

options.name: version
options.description: Print version and exit 0

subcommands.name: registry build
subcommands.description: Materialize a standard canon registry directory from a provider-backed seed corpus and write build provenance to _build.json

options.name: source
options.description: Provider source name

options.name: seed
options.description: Seed CSV or JSONL file used to extract unique identifiers

options.name: seed_column
options.description: Column containing seed identifiers

options.name: output
options.description: Output registry directory to create or update

options.name: version
options.description: Registry version to write into registry.json

options.name: incremental
options.description: Carry forward existing registry entries and fetch only new identifiers

options.name: max_rows
options.description: Refuse if the seed input exceeds N data rows

options.name: max_bytes
options.description: Refuse if the seed input exceeds N bytes

options.name: batch_size
options.description: Override provider batch size

options.name: rate_limit_ms
options.description: Override provider rate-limit delay in milliseconds

options.name: provider_config
options.description: Repeatable provider-specific key=value option such as id_type=ID_ISIN or base_url=http://...

subcommands.name: registry diff
subcommands.description: Compare two versions of the same registry and report added, removed, changed, and unchanged effective mappings

options.name: old
options.description: Older registry directory

options.name: new
options.description: Newer registry directory

options.name: emit
options.description: Output mode: json (structured diff) or summary (human-readable summary line)

subcommands.name: registry audit
subcommands.description: Audit a seed corpus against a registry and report resolved entries, unresolved entries, canonical target counts, and rule-hit counts

options.name: registry
options.description: Registry directory to audit against

options.name: column
options.description: Column containing seed identifiers

options.name: emit
options.description: Output mode: json (structured audit artifact) or summary (human-readable summary line)

options.name: max_rows
options.description: Refuse if the seed input exceeds N data rows

options.name: max_bytes
options.description: Refuse if the seed input exceeds N bytes

refusals.message: Cannot read file or registry path
Column does not exist in header
Unrecognized file extension or parse error
Canonical column name already in CSV header
